```{r decomp stats}

#ANOVA and Tukey - Site comparison
summary(aov(decomp_per_adj ~ factor(Site_ID), data = endbiomass[-1,])) #sig
TukeyHSD(aov(decomp_per_adj ~ factor(Site_ID), data = endbiomass[-1,])) #Flashes > Bick 1 & 2, Amberswood > Bick 1
kruskal.test(decomp_per_adj ~ factor(Site_ID), data = endbiomass[-1,]) #Kruskal-Wallis rank sum test also sig
dunn.test(endbiomass[-1,]$decomp_per_adj, endbiomass[-1,]$Site_ID, method="bonferroni", kw=TRUE) #KW P=0.01, Flashes > Bick 1 & 2 only

#AM association
shapiro.test(resid(lm(decomp_per_adj ~ AM_hyph_per + AM_arb_per + AM_ves_ct, data = endbiomass[-1,]))) #check normality of residuals - normal
summary(aov(decomp_per_adj ~ AM_hyph_per + AM_arb_per + AM_ves_ct, data = endbiomass[-1,])) #hyph almost

#pH
shapiro.test(resid(lm(decomp_per_adj ~ pH, data = endbiomass[-1,]))) #check normality of residuals - normal
summary(aov(decomp_per_adj ~ pH, data = endbiomass[-1,])) #very sig

Anova(lmer(decomp_per_adj ~ pH + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = endbiomass[-1,], #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit), type=3) #pH

decomp_pH_lme <- lmer(decomp_per_adj ~ pH + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = endbiomass[-1,], #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit)
summary(decomp_pH_lme) #random accounts for most variance
shapiro.test(resid(decomp_pH_lme)) #not normal, log was worse
performance::r2(decomp_pH_lme, multivariate=TRUE) #calculate R-squared for model fit
MuMIn::AICc(decomp_pH_lme, k=2) #calculate AICc for for model comparison with small sample sizes

#decomp versus coal waste
shapiro.test(resid(lm(decomp_per_adj ~ rocks_debris + Site_ID, data = endbiomass[-1,]))) #check normality of residuals - normal
summary(aov(decomp_per_adj ~ rocks_debris + Site_ID, data = endbiomass[-1,])) #debris very sig

Anova(lmer(decomp_per_adj ~ rocks_debris + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = endbiomass[-1,], #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit), type=3) #debris

decomp_debris_lme <- lmer(decomp_per_adj ~ rocks_debris + (1|Site_ID), 
    REML = TRUE, #restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for model comparison 
    data = endbiomass[-1,], #choose dataframe
    na.action = na.omit)
summary(decomp_debris_lme) #random accounts for less variance
shapiro.test(resid(decomp_debris_lme)) #normal
performance::r2(decomp_debris_lme, multivariate=TRUE) #calculate R-squared for model fit
MuMIn::AICc(decomp_debris_lme, k=2) #calculate AICc for for model comparison with small sample sizes

#decomp versus worms
shapiro.test(resid(lm(decomp_per_adj ~ worms, data = endbiomass[-1,]))) #check normality of residuals - normal
summary(aov(decomp_per_adj ~ worms, data = endbiomass[-1,])) #not sig

```

```{r coal, warning=FALSE}
ggsave('coal.svg', #save plot name and type - can be "eps", "pdf", "jpeg", "tiff", "png", "bmp", "svg"
	path = "Figures", #save to folder within working directory
	width = 6, height = 4, units = "in", #set dimensions for figure
	dpi = 300, #set resolution
	bg=NULL) #background from plot specifications

```

### Coal calibration samples

#### Percent carbon in coal calibration samples
```{r coal calibration C}

#load csv
coal_quant <- read.csv("coal_quant.csv")

#coal lm plot % carbon vs % coal
ggplot(data = coal_quant, aes(x=per_coal, y=perC)) + 
	geom_point(size=2) +
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE, color=plotline_color, fill=fill_color) +
  scale_x_continuous(name="Coal (%)", breaks = pretty(c(0,100), n=10)) + #set limits and change tick marks on x axis
  scale_y_continuous(name="Carbon (%)", breaks = c(0,10,20,30,40,50,60,70)) + #set limits and change tick marks on y axis
  my_theme

#save figure
ggsave('per_coal_C.svg', #save plot name and type - can be "eps", "pdf", "jpeg", "tiff", "png", "bmp", "svg"
	path = "Figures", #save to folder within working directory
	width = 6, height = 4, units = "in", #set dimensions for figure
	dpi = 300, #set resolution
	bg=NULL) #background from plot specifications

#R-squared for coal calibration
performance::r2(lm(perC ~ per_coal, data = coal_quant)) #adj R-sq value

```

#### C:N in coal calibration samples

```{r coal calibration CN}

#add quadratic term for percent coal 
coal_quant$per_coalsq <- coal_quant$per_coal^2

#create fitted lm and add fitted values to dataframe
coalCN_lm <- lm(CN ~ per_coal + per_coalsq, data = coal_quant)
summary(coalCN_lm) #quadratic term sig
performance::r2(coalCN_lm) #adj R-sq value
coal_quant$CN_fitted <- coalCN_lm$fitted.values #add fitted values to dataframe

#coal lm plot CN vs % coal
ggplot(data = coal_quant, aes(x=per_coal, y=CN)) + 
	geom_point(size=2, mapping = aes(x=per_coal, y=CN)) +
  geom_smooth(mapping = aes(x = per_coal, y = CN_fitted), color=plotline_color) +
  scale_x_continuous(name="Coal (%)", breaks = pretty(c(0,100), n=10)) + #set limits and change tick marks on x axis
  scale_y_continuous(name="C:N Ratio", breaks = c(0,10,20,30,40,50)) + #set limits and change tick marks on y axis
  my_theme

#save figure
ggsave('per_coal_CN.svg', #save plot name and type - can be "eps", "pdf", "jpeg", "tiff", "png", "bmp", "svg"
	path = "Figures", #save to folder within working directory
	width = 6, height = 4, units = "in", #set dimensions for figure
	dpi = 300, #set resolution
	bg=NULL) #background from plot specifications


```
